description.en: Fades a single stand-event dialogue model in or out (enabling it before fading in, disabling it after fading out), without waiting for the fade to finish. See StandEventCharaFadeWait for the array/wait variant.
Handle of the dialogue model to fade.
Target alpha; greater than 0 fades in, 0 or less fades out.
Optional fade duration in frames (defaults to 10).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Fade a single dialogue model in
StandEventCharaFade(hTenmaH, 1.0, 10);
